# Cracktro content rules

Enforced by `docs/tests/talk.spec.ts`. Load before adding public text, data, avatars or images to `deck.js`.

- Everything is public. Use only synthetic examples and role icons, never people. Do not include private repos, `github/<repo>`-style references, 40-hex SHAs, or `who:` fields.
- Exception: the avatars of `pelikhan`, `lpcox`, `dsyme`, `mnkiefer`, `ievangelist`, and `mona` (Mona the Octocat, Push SDLC slide only), as local files `assets/avatars/<login>.jpg` referenced from SVG `<image>` elements. No other avatars or `<image>` sources.
- Exception: the Model routing slide's results panel shows figures measured on gh-aw's own workflows; its speaker notes say so.
- Exception: the Continuous Security slide (`ge-` classes) shows measured counts and dates from The Great Escapi (`firewall-escape` workflow) repo memory (426 escape techniques, 15 Feb to 22 Sep 2026; #401 was the first escape) and the AWF firewall SNI-allowlist fix; the attack diagram is illustrative and its notes say so.
- Exception: the Human Agent Processes slide (`hap-` classes) has a MEASURED column with gh-aw's own counts, 15 Oct to 14 Nov 2026: successful Actions runs of `auto-triage-issues` on issue events (366), `[cli-tools-test]` issues from `daily-cli-tools-tester` (30, 16 completed), pull requests reviewed by `pr-code-quality-reviewer` on ready for review (906) and labelled by `changeset` (9), plus workflow counts per trigger from `.github/workflows` as a 14 Nov 2026 snapshot (3 issues opened, 194 schedule, 8 ready for review, 6 label; smoke tests excluded). The column header says "30 DAYS" and the caption gives both windows; the flows are illustrative and its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Pull Request Review² slide (`prq-` classes) has a bottom strip of measured counts for gh-aw merged PRs, 15 Oct to 13 Nov 2026: 938 of 1,263 checked by the Matt Pocock Skills Reviewer, PR Code Quality Reviewer or Test Quality Sentinel workflows, 1,337 agentic reviews, 1,612 inline threads, 517 PR Sous Chef `@copilot` nudges on 336 PRs, 965 Copilot fix commits on 305 PRs, 1.8 h median ready-for-review to merge. The flow and its open-thread counter are illustrative; its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Issues as intent slide (18) shows real counts for gh-aw issues labelled `community` and the merged PRs that closed them (November 2026 snapshot); its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Daily Unsloppers slide (`du-` classes) has a measured panel of gh-aw's `[duplicate-code]` issues from the Duplicate Code Detector (7 Oct 2025 to 26 Oct 2026: 211 filed, 144 assigned to Copilot, 115 closed by merged PRs, 3.8 h median issue to merge, monthly filed/merged bars; November 2026 snapshot); the flow and files are illustrative and its notes say so.
- Exception: the Merge fast, unslop daily slide (21, `mfu-` panel plus `us-` lanes) shows gh-aw's measured merge cadence for 15 Oct to 13 Nov 2026 (1,263 merged PRs, 42/day, median 166 lines and 1h54m to merge, per-day bars, unslopper PRs on 25 of 30 days) and all-time merged clean-up PRs by title prefix for jsweep, dead-code-remover, code-simplifier, tidy, daily-file-diet and duplicate-code-detector (427 PRs, +34,691 −44,700 lines, 261 days, 26 Sep 2025 to 12 Nov 2026; 14 Nov 2026 snapshot). The panel label and caption state each data window; the two lanes are illustrative and notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Research · Assign · Observe slide (`rob-` classes) has a measured panel of gh-aw's `daily-cli-performance` `[performance] Regression in ...` issues, 13 Mar to 25 Oct 2026: 116 filed, 101 assigned to Copilot, 72 picked by Issue Monster, 62 closed by merged Copilot fixes (median 6.8 h, 55 within a day), five dated regression/fix rows, and 101 daily benchmark snapshots (5 Apr to 13 Nov) in its repo memory. The production fleet, spans and loop are simulated; its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Query · Ask · Grow slide (`otg-` classes) has a bottom timeline of gh-aw's measured `[otel-advisor]`/`[grafana-otel-advisor]` issues (5 Apr to 9 Jun 2026, day offsets in `DAYS`); the loop above it is illustrative and its notes say so.
- Exception: the Mine · Refine · Apply slide (`mra-` classes) shows real gh-aw data, 15 May to 11 Nov 2026: a dated feed of merged `[linter-miner]` analyzers (with their ordinal of 65), `[lint-monster]` issues and Copilot cleanup PRs, plus counts (73 analyzer PRs, 65 merged, 376 reviews, 235 LintMonster issues, 92 merged cleanup PRs, 54,128 lines). The loop is illustrative; notes and caption say so. Feed authors are agents only (`linter miner`, `lintmonster`, `copilot`).
- Exception: the Explore · Reuse · Lint slide (25, `exr-` grid, `exm-` measured strip) has a bottom strip measured from Sergo's `memory/sergo` repo memory and gh-aw issues/PRs labelled `sergo`, 16 Apr to 14 Nov 2026: findings per run by month (8.3 in May to 3.3 in October; no runs cached in August), the 13 merged PRs from the cached `paren_unwrap_gap` strategy (31 Oct to 12 Nov) among Sergo's 17 merged own PRs, three shortened real cache entries, and counts (128 runs, 667 findings, 287 issues, 164 merged fix PRs). Each panel labels its own window and the caption gives the overall window and snapshot date. The pattern grid above is illustrative; notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Semantic clustering slide (`sd-` classes) shows the real functions, files and counts from gh-aw's Semantic Function Refactoring report of 7 May 2026 (issue 30711) and the merged PR 30770 that closed it; the scan, beams and chip animation are illustrative. Its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Spec · Model · Test slide (27, `fv-`/`smt-` classes) shows measured gh-aw `specs/work-queue` counts (16 TLA+ modules, 218 TLC configs, 99 mutants, 55 witnesses, 35 merged PRs since 2 Oct 2026), the daily formal verification run of 11 Nov 2026 (FairDAGGitHub 1,055,182 distinct states; QueueOrdering open after 4 h 40 m) and the 7 Oct 2026 record (BrokenCAS 735 states, NoOutOfOrderClaim witness 756 states); invariant names are real, the excerpt is abridged and the flow is illustrative. The ledger header states the 2 Oct – 14 Nov 2026 (43 days) window and each run line its date; its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Go Fan slide (`gf-` classes) shows real counts of gh-aw `[go-fan]` review issues, the merged PRs that closed them, and shortened PR titles (February to November 2026); its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Spec-driven testing slide (29, `sdd-`/`sdm-` classes) has a bottom strip of measured gh-aw counts, 30 Mar to 14 Nov 2026: merged PRs by title prefix (83 `[spec-extractor]`, 69 `[spec-enforcer]` adding 12,731 lines, 22 `[spec-review]`), 68 `[spec-librarian]` audit issues and 38 merged Copilot fix PRs, and `TestSpec_` functions in `pkg/` on main growing from 0 to 415 (48 `spec_test.go` files). The `pkg/ctxutil` change, README spec and spec tests in the flow are an illustrative excerpt; its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Docs that heal slide (30, `dh-`/`dhm-` classes) has a bottom strip of measured gh-aw data (14 Nov 2026 snapshot): merged `[docs]` PRs per agent attributed by workflow marker, footer or title (189 daily-doc-updater, 250 unbloat-docs cutting a net 22,043 lines, 146 glossary-maintainer, 64 daily-doc-healer, 10 Oct 2025 to 14 Nov 2026) and a timeline of all 29 `[doc-healer]` issues (26 Feb to 30 Oct 2026; caption states both windows; 13 closed by merged PRs, 9 changing the updater's prompt). The workflow, page and noob tester report in the loop are illustrative; notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the Speak · Map · Grep slide (`dg-` classes) shows spoken forms from gh-aw's real `DICTATION.md` and names its dictation and function-namer workflows; grep counts and renames are synthetic, the maintainer is the pelikhan avatar, and its notes say so.
- Exception: workflow slides (those listed in `workflow-prompts.md`) show the real first user message of the Copilot session that created their gh-aw workflow as an `.awp` `/agentic-workflows` line, with the full prompt in the click-to-open `.awd` dialog. The text is verbatim minus URLs, and it names no people. Sources are in `workflow-prompts.md`.
- Exception: the Push SDLC slide (`psd-` classes) names the public `github/squad` project; the test's repo-reference regex allows only `github/squad`. Its task, repo and files are synthetic and its notes say so.
- Exception: the Scan · Fix · Learn slide (32, `sfm-` panel) shows measured counts from the public .NET runtime repository's `ci-failure-scan`, `ci-failure-fix` and `ci-failure-scan-feedback` workflows (window 5 May to 14 Nov 2026, 193 days, labelled on the panel: 305 `[ci-scan]` issues, 270 closed; 22 `[ci-fix]` PRs, 5 merged; 12 merged `[ci-scan-feedback]` prompt-edit PRs; 882 runs; issues per month). The loop below it is illustrative; its notes and caption say so.
- Exception: the data slides before the finale. "First commit to GA" (`hist-` classes), shows gh-aw's measured public history (git on main plus GitHub search counts, 12 Aug 2025 to GA on 28 Oct 2026); its speaker notes give the sources and say account attribution is not proof of AI use. "How PRs land" (`land-` classes), shows measured time-to-merge and lines-changed distributions of merged PRs, split by the same origins; issues opened under a person's account may still have been drafted in the Copilot app or CLI, which GitHub does not record. "How workflows evolve" (`evo-` classes), shows measured first-parent commits on main that changed `.github/workflows/**/*.md` (monthly by author type, live workflow count, lines-changed histogram and statistical tests: Spearman, Mann–Whitney, Gini), 12 Aug 2025 to GA; its notes give the method.
- The only URL allowed in `deck.js` is `https://github.github.com/gh-aw/introduction/overview/`.
- Speaker notes of every slide marked `illustrative` in `slides.md` must match `/illustrative|synthetic|simulated/i`.
- Never write slide numbers or slide counts outside `slides.md`; refer to slides by heading and CSS prefix.
- No external requests and no page errors.
